    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = in.nextLong();
        long m = in.nextLong();
        long p = in.nextLong();
        long q = in.nextLong();
        long total = q - p + 1;
        long oddCount = (p % 2 == 0) ? total - (total / 2) : (total + 1) / 2;
        long evenCount = total - oddCount;
        long cells = n * m;
        if ((n & m) % 2 == 0) {
            long result = computeEvenParity(oddCount, evenCount, cells);
            System.out.println(result);
        } else {
            long result = powerMod(oddCount + evenCount, cells);
            System.out.println(result);
        }
    }

    private static long computeEvenParity(long odd, long even, long steps) {
        if (steps == 1) return odd;
        if (steps % 2 == 1) {
            long prev = computeEvenParity(odd, even, steps - 1);
            return (odd * prev % MOD + even * computeEvenParity(odd, even, steps - 1, 1) % MOD) % MOD;
        } else {
            long a = computeEvenParity(odd, even, steps / 2, 0);
            long b = computeEvenParity(odd, even, steps / 2, 1);
            return (a * a % MOD + b * b % MOD) % MOD;
        }
    }

    private static long computeEvenParity(long odd, long even, long steps, int parity) {
        if (steps == 1) return (parity == 0) ? even : odd;
        if (steps % 2 == 1) {
            long prev0 = computeEvenParity(odd, even, steps - 1, 0);
            long prev1 = computeEvenParity(odd, even, steps - 1, 1);
            if (parity == 0) {
                return (odd * prev0 % MOD + even * prev1 % MOD) % MOD;
            } else {
                return (odd * prev1 % MOD + even * prev0 % MOD) % MOD;
            }
        } else {
            long a0 = computeEvenParity(odd, even, steps / 2, 0);
            long a1 = computeEvenParity(odd, even, steps / 2, 1);
            if (parity == 0) {
                return (a0 * a0 % MOD + a1 * a1 % MOD) % MOD;
            } else {
                return (2 * a0 * a1 % MOD) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    private static long powerMod(long base, long exp) {
        if (exp == 0) return 1;
        if (exp == 1) return base % MOD;
        long half = powerMod(base, exp / 2);
        if (exp % 2 == 0) {
            return half * half % MOD;
        } else {
            return half * half % MOD * base % MOD;
        }
    }
